actors.name: Matteo Salvini
actors.role: Deputy Prime Minister of Italy, Leader of Lega
actors.blurb: Salvini is driving significant coverage due to his controversial policy proposals, including a 5% levy on bank profits and his stance on migration. His leadership within the Lega party is under scrutiny following internal dissent and calls for his resignation. His recent public appearances, including at a De André tribute concert, have sparked backlash and debates over his political alignment and influence.
